preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of flights m must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi in flights)
preconditions.description: Each flight must connect two distinct cities within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'No' or start with 'Yes' followed by m lines of flight durations.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout == 'Yes' and all(d in ['1', '2'] for d in durations) for durations in generate_durations(flights))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the flight durations must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: all(travel_time(1, n, flights, durations) == travel_time(1, n, flights, [1] * m) for durations in generate_durations(flights))
postconditions.description: All valid flight duration assignments must result in equal travel times from city 1 to city n.
